recognize_zh: 鐵染色（Prussian blue）下，多個紅血球前驅細胞的核周圍有一圈藍色鐵顆粒，至少包住核周三分之一以上，形成環狀；這些就是環狀鐵粒幼紅血球（ring sideroblasts）。
features: Multiple erythroid precursors with coarse blue siderotic granules arranged in a perinuclear ring
Granules encircle a third or more of the nuclear circumference in many cells
Nuclei counterstained pink (nuclear fast red); some precursors show scattered non-ring granules
Occasional coarse extracellular/macrophage iron fragments in the background
Granulocytic precursors without iron granules for comparison
describe_en: Prussian blue iron stain of a bone marrow aspirate shows numerous erythroid precursors containing coarse blue siderotic granules arranged in a perinuclear ring encircling at least one-third of the nucleus, diagnostic of ring sideroblasts. Other erythroid precursors show scattered non-ring granules, and granulocytic precursors are negative. Ring sideroblasts should be enumerated as a percentage of erythroid precursors (≥15%, or ≥5% with SF3B1 mutation, for MDS with ring sideroblasts). Findings are consistent with ring sideroblastic erythropoiesis; correlation with blast count, dysplasia, SF3B1 status, and reversible causes (alcohol, isoniazid, copper deficiency, zinc excess) is required.

ddx.vs: Normal sideroblasts contain only a few fine granules scattered in the cytoplasm without a perinuclear ring.

ddx.dx: Reactive sideroblastic anemia (alcohol, isoniazid, copper deficiency)
ddx.vs: Morphologically identical ring sideroblasts; separated by history, reversibility, copper/zinc levels, and absence of SF3B1 mutation or clonal cytogenetics.
Presents early in life with microcytic hypochromic red cells, family history, and germline ALAS2/SLC25A38 mutation rather than acquired macrocytosis with dysplasia.

ddx.dx: MDS/MPN with SF3B1 mutation and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: Also has ring sideroblasts but shows platelet count ≥450 × 10^9/L with large atypical megakaryocytes.
